title.en: Know when your TeX packages are out of date

body.en: Lattice tells you when your TeX packages are out of date and offers a one-click update.
body.zh: TeX 包过期时，Lattice 会提醒你，并提供一键更新。

title.en: Newer default model in the AI assistant
title.zh: AI 助手默认使用更新的模型

body.en: "sonnet" and "haiku" now mean Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5, the default model is Sonnet 5.5, and Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.2 show their real default effort.
body.zh: “sonnet” 和 “haiku” 现在指 Sonnet 5.5 和 Haiku 5.5，默认模型为 Sonnet 5.5，Opus 5.5 和 Fable 5.2 会显示真实的默认推理强度。

fixes.en: In an Overleaf project, the PDF your build makes is no longer synced to or from Overleaf, so a collaborator's PDF can no longer replace yours when the main document sits in a subfolder (such as cvpr/main.tex). If the PDF is replaced anyway, Lattice rebuilds instead of showing someone else's PDF.
fixes.zh: 在 Overleaf 项目中，你编译生成的 PDF 不再与 Overleaf 同步；主文档位于子文件夹（如 cvpr/main.tex）时，合作者的 PDF 不会再覆盖你的 PDF。即使 PDF 被替换，Lattice 也会重新编译，而不是显示别人的 PDF。

fixes.en: Ctrl/⌘ + wheel zoom in the PDF keeps the point under the pointer instead of jumping to another page. Thanks to @Livioni.
fixes.zh: 在 PDF 中用 Ctrl/⌘ + 滚轮缩放时，指针下的位置保持不动，不再跳到其他页。感谢 @Livioni。

fixes.en: Drag-selecting text past the edge of the editor scrolls smoothly. Thanks to @wchen99998.
fixes.zh: 拖选文本超出编辑器边缘时，滚动更加流畅。感谢 @wchen99998。
